labels.name: Normal Blood
labels.note: A tube title printed under a hematocrit tube. Questions on this figure (anp-blood-composition-3, anp-erythrocytes-17) ask the student to read the tubes and name which is normal, low or high, so the titles would give the answers away. Covered for good; the normal ranges stay visible.
